page.overview:
What is Zellea, the Forbidden Land?

Zellea, the Forbidden Land , or Jagd Zellea is the name of a jagd in Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift. It is located north of Loar and west of Ordalia.

The player is automatically transported here when the storyline calls for it, but before the final mission, Luso can teleport here from Lezaford's Cottage in the Aldanna Range and back. Zellea is the stage of the finale of the game. It is also the location of Brightmoon Tor's third entrance.

Zellea also appears in Crystal Defenders.

The name "Zellea, the Forbidden Land" is a reference to Eureka, the Forbidden Land from Final Fantasy III.
